Messages.Author: Ben Swainbank
Messages.Body:
If I have an untapped Erciyes Fragment and I oust my prey, is there a
"timing window" during which I can tap Erciyes and get a card that was
in play prior to the oust? Do cards burned by a player being ousted
hit the ash heap before they are removed from play?

-Ben Swainbank

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


No. They burn, but the ash heaps of ousted players cannot be reached
by game effects.

--

Messages.Author: Colin McGuigan
Messages.Body:
Kulaid wrote:
> Can't you do it before the action to oust them is completed?
> IE... You have a govern on the fragment... Burn it for a 3 bleed
> with your prey at 3 pool and unable to block, tap it to get a card on
> it before the action is successful?

That is possible, yes.

However, the OP was asking about getting a card that would be burnt
because of them being ousted, eg, a Barrens or Fame or the like, which
is in play, but goes to the ash heap when its controller is ousted.

--Colin McGuigan
